rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a text message sent to a mobile phone.

example.english: I just received Ming's text message saying he’ll be late because of traffic.
example.traditional: 我啱啱收到阿明嘅短訊，佢話塞車會遲到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 sau1 dou2 aa3 ming4 ge3 dyun2 seon3 keoi5 waa6 sak1 ce1 wui5 ci4 dou3
